SELECT bb.borrow_id, bb.user_id, bb.book_id, bb.borrow_time, bb.expected_return_time, bb.actual_return_time, bb.renew_count, bb.renew_days, bb.borrow_status, bb.operation_type, bb.return_apply_time, bi.book_id, bi.book_name, bi.author, bi.cover_url, bc.category_code, bc.category_name, su.username as user_name, su.uid FROM book_borrow bb LEFT JOIN book_info bi ON bb.book_id = bi.book_id LEFT JOIN book_category bc ON bi.category_id = bc.category_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON bb.user_id = su.user_id WHERE bb.user_id = #{userId} AND bb.borrow_status IN (0, 2)
AND ( bi.book_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') OR bi.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') )
AND bc.category_code = #{param.categoryCode}
ORDER BY bb.expected_return_time

SELECT bb.borrow_id, -- 书籍信息 bi.book_id, bi.book_name, bi.author, bi.isbn, bi.cover_url, bi.publisher, bi.publish_date, -- 分类信息 bc.category_id, bc.category_code, bc.category_name, -- 用户信息 su.user_id, su.username as user_name, su.uid, su.avatar, -- 借阅信息 bb.borrow_time, bb.expected_return_time, bb.actual_return_time, bb.return_apply_time, bb.return_confirm_status, bb.renew_count, bb.borrow_status FROM book_borrow bb LEFT JOIN book_info bi ON bb.book_id = bi.book_id LEFT JOIN book_category bc ON bi.category_id = bc.category_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON bb.user_id = su.user_id WHERE bb.borrow_status = 3 -- 归还待确认状态（删除is_deleted条件）
AND ( bi.book_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') OR bi.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') OR su.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') OR su.uid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') )
AND bc.category_code = #{param.categoryCode}
ORDER BY bb.return_apply_time DESC, bb.borrow_time DESC

SELECT bb.*, su.username as user_name, su.uid, su.avatar, bi.book_name, bi.author, bi.cover_url, bi.category_id, bc.category_code, bc.category_name, au.username as admin_name FROM book_borrow bb LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON bb.user_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN book_info bi ON bb.book_id = bi.book_id LEFT JOIN book_category bc ON bi.category_id = bc.category_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON bb.confirm_admin_id = au.user_id WHERE bb.borrow_id = #{borrowId} LIMIT 1
